metadata.description: Maps Hunter.io API response fields to the pipeline's internal output schema. Used by the Hunter enrichment stage to extract and normalise Hunter data before merging with lead records.

domain.description: The business domain returned by Hunter. Used to populate the Website output column if no website was found during scraping.

email.description: The highest-confidence email address returned by Hunter domain search or email finder.

confidence.description: Hunter.io confidence score (0–100). Stored in the Hunter Score output column. Scores below 70 are deprioritised.

verification.description: Hunter verification status: valid, accept_all, invalid, disposable, webmail. Used to set the Email Source output column value to hunter_domain or hunter_finder.

firstName.description: Contact first name from Hunter. Stored as an internal enrichment field. Not included in the final export columns.

lastName.description: Contact last name from Hunter. Stored as an internal enrichment field. Not included in the final export columns.

position.description: Job title or position of the contact returned by Hunter. Stored as an internal enrichment field for scoring purposes. Not included in the final export columns.

company.description: Company or organisation name returned by Hunter. Used for cross-validation against the scraped business name. Not included in the final export columns.

domainSearch.primaryUseCase: Find all known emails for a business domain. Triggered when a website is available for a lead.

emailFinder.primaryUseCase: Guess the email address of a named contact at a domain. Triggered when domain search returns no usable results.

emailVerifier.primaryUseCase: Verify deliverability of an email address found by scraping or Hunter.

authentication.note: API key must be set as the n8n environment variable HUNTER_API_KEY. Never hardcode in a workflow node.
